# 🧩 Feature Proposal

## 🎯 Concrete use case

What application behavior do you need? What currently blocks it?

## ✍️ Proposed source/API

Show a minimal proposed form and label it as future syntax.

## ⚙️ Semantics and implementation impact

Describe types, evaluation/lifecycle behavior, and likely front-end/IR/DEX/UI/package changes. Identify a roadmap phase/dependency.

## 🧪 Acceptance criteria

What source errors, binary checks and device behavior would prove completion?

## 📋 Alternatives and scope

List a narrower implementation if useful and clarify what remains out of scope.
